title: Liquid Waste Treatment by Road
bodyHtml:
Calice Treatment Plant

The sewage treatment plant is located inside the Calice depuration plant and has been active since 1992.
The plant consists of 2 disposal lines, the first dedicated to the treatment of E.E.R. codes 20.03.4 - 20.03.06 and a capacity of 2,250 tons/week, 117,000 tons/year.
The second dedicated to the treatment of E.E.R. codes 19.07.03 - 16.10.02 and a potential of 3,750 + 20% t/week, 195,000 t/year.

The I.T.L. of Calice has the following schedule:
     from 7.30 to 19.00 every weekday;
     from 7.30 to 12.00 on Saturdays;
Weekly closing: during public holidays

Baciacavallo treatment plant

The slurry treatment plant is located inside the Baciacavallo depuration plant and has been active since 2016.
The plant consists of 1 disposal line dedicated to the treatment of E.E.R. codes 20.03.4 and a capacity of 230 t/day, 900 t/week.

The I.T.L. of Baciacavallo has the following schedule:
     from 7.00 to 18.30 every weekday;
     from 7.00 to 12.00 on Saturdays;
Weekly closing: during public holidays
